title: Listening Drill — Training volunteer readers
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Training volunteer readers
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on training volunteer readers. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with a pilot class. At the time our biggest obstacle was tutor shortages. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered different goals. It helped us improve session planning. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll invite a fresh group of volunteers. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
